about: Differences between picosim and the real RP2040 that are understood. tests/test_hwfacts.py fails only on a difference that is not listed here. Each entry matches by class (faults, decoder, flags, memory, timing), a regex on the encoding's name (from picosim/discover/v6m.py), and optionally regexes on the detail and on 'code' (the first instruction's bytes in hex as stored: '00bc' is 0xBC00). 'reason' is shown in report.md; 'todo' is what is still to decide or do.

known.name: ^CPS \(should-be bits wrong\)$
known.reason: UNPREDICTABLE encoding: CPS with its should-be bits 3:0 not 0010. The RP2040 ignores bits 3:0: 0xB660-0xB66F act as CPSIE i and 0xB670-0xB67F as CPSID i (PRIMASK read back, all 32 forms). picosim stops with 'Undefined instruction ... not a Cortex-M0+ instruction'.
known.todo: Awaiting the user's decision (plan §9, S19 proposal 7): keep stopping (GNU as never emits these), but say the encoding is UNPREDICTABLE and what the Pico does, instead of 'not a Cortex-M0+ instruction'.

known.name: ^POP \{list\}$
known.reason: UNPREDICTABLE encoding: POP {} (0xBC00, empty register list). The RP2040 loads PC from [SP] and leaves SP unchanged (it branched to the word at SP). picosim does nothing and falls through.
known.todo: Awaiting the user's decision (plan §9, S19 proposal 8): stop with an 'UNPREDICTABLE: empty register list' message, as for other encodings the Pico does not define (GNU as rejects an empty list).

known.name: ^LDM Rn\{!\},\{list\}$
known.reason: UNPREDICTABLE encoding: LDM Rn!,{} (0xC800-0xCF00, empty register list). The RP2040 loads PC from [Rn] (7 of 8 then HardFault on the ROM word they load; 0xCA00 runs boot-ROM code and lands in the sled), Rn unchanged. picosim does nothing and falls through.
known.todo: Awaiting the user's decision (plan §9, S19 proposal 8): stop with an 'UNPREDICTABLE: empty register list' message.

known.name: ^STM Rn!,\{list\}$
known.reason: UNPREDICTABLE encoding: STM Rn!,{} (0xC000-0xC700, empty register list). The RP2040 adds 4 to Rn (it stores one word; B's cases aim it at ROM, so what it stores is not seen). picosim leaves Rn unchanged.
known.todo: Awaiting the user's decision (plan §9, S19 proposal 8): stop with an 'UNPREDICTABLE: empty register list' message. To learn what the chip stores, run the eight forms with Rn in the scratch window.
